q1.question: How do I add images?
q1.answer: You can simply drag and drop images into the designated area or click the "Select Files" button to upload them from your device.

q2.question: How can I edit a single image?
q2.answer: Click the magic wand button () on an image card. A window will open with all editing options.

q3.question: How do I save the edited images?
q3.answer: Select the desired images by clicking on their cards, then click "Save As…" in the top bar.

q4.question: Which image formats are supported?
q4.answer: The application supports PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, and GIF, depending on your browser's capabilities.

q5.question: Can I download multiple images as a ZIP file?
q5.answer: Yes. Select the images and click the "ZIP" button in the toolbar.

q6.question: How do I create a PDF file from my images?
q6.answer: You can export either all images or selected ones as PDF using the respective buttons.

q7.question: What happens if I close the browser window?
q7.answer: All images are stored locally, so they will be lost if you close the window. Save your work regularly.

q8.question: How do I remove images from the list?
q8.answer: Click the red X icon on individual cards or use the "Delete" button for multiple selections.

blog.title: Complete Guide to the Browser-Based Batch Image Editor
blog.subtitle: Everything you need to know about the features and functions of this modern image editing tool
blog.intro: Our browser-based batch image editor offers a comprehensive set of tools for image editing - all locally in your browser without server uploads. Here you will find everything you need to know about the various features.

upload.title: 1. Uploading Images
upload.intro: The application supports various methods for loading images:

dragdrop.title: Drag & Drop
dragdrop.text: Drag image files directly from your file manager onto the drop zone.

fileselect.title: File Selection
fileselect.text: Click the "Select Files" button to open the file dialog.

formats.title: Supported Formats
formats.text: All common image formats are supported: PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, GIF, and more.

rotate.title: Rotate
rotate.text: Rotate images in 90° steps (left, right) or 180°.

resize.title: Resize
resize.text: Change dimensions with optional aspect ratio lock.

crop.title: Aspect Ratio
crop.text: Crop to predefined aspect ratios like 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or custom values.

filters.title: 3. Filters & Effects
filters.intro: Comprehensive filter options for image enhancement:

brightness.title: Brightness
brightness.text: Adjust the image brightness from -100 to +100.

contrast.title: Contrast
contrast.text: Control the contrast for more vivid or softer images.

hue.title: Hue
hue.text: Rotate through the full color spectrum (0° - 360°).

blur.title: Blur
blur.text: Soft blur effect from 0 to 10 pixels.

batch.title: 4. Batch Processing
batch.intro: The highlight of this tool - efficient batch processing:

multiselect.title: Multi-Selection
multiselect.text: Click on image cards to select them. Hold Ctrl/Cmd for multiple selection.

selectall.title: Select All
selectall.text: The "Select All" button selects or deselects all images at once.

batchfilters.title: Batch Filters
batchfilters.text: Apply filters to all selected images simultaneously.

bulkrename.title: Bulk Rename
bulkrename.text: Rename multiple images sequentially (e.g., Vacation_1, Vacation_2, ...).

batchexport.title: Batch Export
batchexport.text: Export all selected images in one go as ZIP or PDF.

editor.title: 5. Detailed Image Editor
editor.intro: For precise individual editing, click the magic wand icon:

preview.title: Live Preview
preview.text: All changes are immediately visible in the preview.

rename.title: Rename
rename.text: Change the file name directly in the editor.

transform.title: Transformations
transform.text: Rotate, flip, and resize individual images.

export.title: Direct Export
export.text: Download the edited image directly in your preferred format.

pdf.title: 6. PDF Export
pdf.intro: Powerful PDF features for professional documents:

settings.title: Document Settings
settings.text: Title, author, orientation (portrait/landscape) and file names below images.

titlepage.title: Title Page
titlepage.text: Optional title page with title and date.

designer.title: Front Page Designer
designer.text: Design a custom front page with texts and images using drag & drop.

comments.title: Comment Pages
comments.text: Multi-page comment section with texts and images at the end of the PDF.

optimization.title: File Size Optimization
optimization.text: Optional compression for smaller PDF files.

naming.title: Custom File Name
naming.text: Choose the name for your ZIP archive.

date.title: Automatic Date
date.text: The current date is automatically appended (e.g., images_2025-01-15.zip).

progress.title: Progress Indicator
progress.text: Live progress display during ZIP creation.

svg.title: 8. SVG Conversion
svg.intro: Convert raster images to vector graphics:

conversion.title: Automatic Vectorization
conversion.text: Converts bitmap images to scalable SVG format.

scalable.title: Infinite Scalability
scalable.text: SVG images can be scaled to any size without quality loss.

usecase.title: Use Cases
usecase.text: Ideal for logos, icons, and simple graphics.

list.png: PNG - Lossless, high quality, ideal for graphics with transparency
list.jpg: JPEG - Compressed, smaller files, ideal for photos
list.webp: WebP - Modern format, best compression, supported by all current browsers

quality.title: Quality Setting
quality.text: For JPEG and WebP you can set the compression quality (1-100%).

toolbar.title: Toolbar
toolbar.text: All important functions available at the top in the status bar.

cards.title: Image Cards
cards.text: Each image is displayed as a card with preview and quick actions.

modals.title: Modal Dialogs
modals.text: Clear dialogs for complex operations like PDF export.

responsive.title: Responsive
responsive.text: Optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

languages.title: Available Languages
languages.text: German and English with complete translations of all texts.

detection.title: Automatic Detection
detection.text: The language is automatically detected from browser settings.

switch.title: Easy Switching
switch.text: One-click language switching in the header.

persistence.title: Persistence
persistence.text: The selected language is saved in the browser.

theme.title: 12. Light & Dark Mode
theme.intro: Comfortable working in any lighting condition:

modes.title: Two Modes
modes.text: Light mode for bright environments, dark mode for evening work.

system.title: System Detection
system.text: Automatic adaptation to your operating system's preferences.

toggle.title: Easy Switching
toggle.text: One click on the theme button in the header.

persistence.title: Persistence
persistence.text: Your preference is saved in the browser.

navigation.title: Navigation
navigation.text: Arrow keys for navigating between images.

actions.title: Actions
actions.text: Delete key to remove selected images.

privacy.title: 14. Privacy
privacy.intro: Your privacy is our top priority:

local.title: Local Processing
local.text: All image processing happens exclusively in your browser.

noupload.title: No Server Uploads
noupload.text: Your images never leave your device.

notracking.title: No Tracking
notracking.text: No cookies, no analytics, no data collection.

opensource.title: Open Source
opensource.text: The code is open and reviewable.

conclusion.title: Conclusion
conclusion.text: Our browser-based batch image editor combines powerful features with maximum privacy. Whether you want to edit a single image or process hundreds at once - everything happens locally, fast, and secure.
